stations.role: Bind config, repository HEAD, declared artifacts and command identities by digest.
stations.promotion_limit: Identity/integrity does not prove semantic correctness.

stations.role: Execute declared correctness cases and compare exit/output digests.
stations.promotion_limit: Equality is limited to executed cases; external accuracy needs a declared reference.

stations.role: Collect optional syscall/performance-counter-facing evidence without merging it into timing truth.
stations.promotion_limit: Unexposed or rejected probes stay TOKEN_VAZIO; VM visibility is not physical-wire visibility.

stations.role: Collect rotating-interleaved raw wall-clock samples with reduced output observer load.
Compute paired deltas against a baseline and enumerate declared factor differences.
stations.promotion_limit: Results remain OBSERVED_UNPROMOTED; metadata alone does not isolate causality.

stations.role: Compute descriptive robustness metrics and a non-parametric median interval when sample count permits.
stations.promotion_limit: Inference assumptions are explicit and do not establish universal truth.

stations.role: Compare multiple receipts for config/source/output identity and cross-environment execution reproduction.
stations.promotion_limit: Independent-provider reproduction requires an actually independent provider receipt.

stations.role: Expose only bounded statements supported by prior stations and preserve open gaps.
stations.promotion_limit: V1 claim_allowed remains false; domain-specific promotion is external.

statistics.interval: 95% exact order-statistic/binomial interval for the median when n is sufficient
